title: Customer Experience Executive – Inbound Lead Qualification
description:
**About Duratuf**

We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in Dubai  
Our equipment keeps workers safe at **4,142+ customers** across **65+ countries** — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family.  
We're on our way to **10,000 protected workplaces by 2035**

**About the Role**

* This seat sits at the front of the Customer Experience team and owns every inbound enquiry from the moment it lands.
* You qualify the enquiry, separate real buyers from noise, and hand clean opportunities to Sales.
* You cover all inbound channels during working hours: calls, WhatsApp Business, LiveChat, email and B2B platforms.

**Lead Qualification (Core of the Role)**

* Screen every inbound enquiry against MOQ, product feasibility and customer segment (distributor / EPC / end-user / OEM / government)
* Make correct qualify or reject decisions with minimal supervision
* Flag junk or irrelevant enquiries to the manager the same day and never pass them forward

**Multi-Channel Inbound Handling**

* Own all inbound touchpoints during working hours with zero missed enquiries
* Maintain First Response Time of 15 minutes or less on every channel
* Handle MOQ, price and product-fit questions without escalating every touchpoint

**Clean Handoff to Sales**

* Transfer every qualified lead with full context: company info, product interest, MOQ fit and conversation history

**CRM Hygiene**

* Log every enquiry and lead in Zoho CRM in the same session, tagged by stage
* Maintain 100% data completeness with zero pending updates beyond end of day
* Complete 100% of follow-ups within TAT

**Pipeline Reporting**

* Hold a weekly review with the Support Manager covering enquiries handled, response rate, qualification accuracy and conversion funnel

**What Success Looks Like**

* Zero missed inbound touchpoints
* First Response Time ≤ 15 minutes on every channel
* ≥ 90% lead-qualification accuracy
* 100% follow-up completion within TAT
* Every interaction logged in Zoho CRM the same session

**Requirements**

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 1–2 years in BPO (voice or chat), customer support, customer experience, inbound telecalling, inside sales or B2B enquiry handling
* Education: Graduate (any stream)
* Language: Fluent in English and Hindi, with the ability to understand Bengali
* Industry preference: B2B / Industrial / Manufacturing (PPE exposure preferred)

**Technical Skills**

* Familiarity with Zoho CRM, Zoho SalesIQ and WhatsApp Business (strong plus)
* Ability to manage multi-channel communication simultaneously
* Basic proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets
* Exposure to B2B trade platforms such as IndiaMART and TradeIndia (preferred)
* Exposure to any AI-based tool (nice to have)

**Functional Skills**

* Lead-qualification logic: knowing when to qualify and when to reject
* Composure and multitasking under load, with calls, chats and CRM updates running at once
* Process discipline: follows the SOP and qualification steps consistently and logs as you go
* Empathy, patience and professional phone and chat etiquette

**Values Fit (Non-Negotiable)**

* **Integrity:** pipeline data and follow-up logs reflect reality, with no inflated counts and no follow-ups marked done that weren't
* **Accountability:** owns FRT, follow-up completion and qualification accuracy as personal numbers, without being chased
* **Adaptability:** picks up new tools and products quickly and adapts to each customer rather than relying on fixed scripts

**Benefits**

* Flexible leave policy
* WFH and out-of-office opportunities based on requirements and conditions
* Performance incentives
* Performance recognition
* Dynamic career growth
* Statutory benefits as per industry standards
* Everything runs on Zoho One (modern, integrated tool stack)

Pay: ₹250,000.00 - ₹320,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Territory Manager - Kolkata
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

**Your Role: Territory Sales Manager - Pet Health**

As a Territory Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales growth and strengthening Elanco’s presence in the assigned region by engaging with veterinary professionals, farm owners, and distributors. Your role will focus on building strong customer relationships, executing company strategies, and ensuring timely product movement and payment collection.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* Meet with veterinarians and other key customers to promote animal health products and generate profitable sales.
* Collaborate with distributors to drive product liquidation and encourage repeat purchasing.
* Follow up on outstanding payments from customers and distributors to ensure timely collections.
* Implement company strategies in the field, monitor competitor activity, and provide timely feedback.
* Achieve sales targets and maintain accurate records of customer and territory data.

**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary Science, Animal Husbandry, Agriculture, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Prior experience in animal health or pharmaceutical sales, preferably in a territory-based role.
* **Top Skills:** Strong communication, relationship management, and sales execution skills.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (preferred qualifications):**

* Strong understanding of the animal health market, including veterinary channels and livestock farming.
* Experience working with distributors and managing accounts receivable.
* Proven ability to meet sales targets and execute field strategies effectively.
* High levels of ethics, self-discipline, and accountability.
* Proficiency in reporting systems and Microsoft Office tools.

**Additional Information:**

* **Location:** Based in India – field-based role covering an assigned sales territory.
* **Travel:** Frequent travel required within the assigned region for customer engagement and distributor meetings.
* Must attend company meetings and training sessions as scheduled and comply with all company policies and reporting systems.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown underrecognized groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Elanco we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or other roles!

Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status

title: BC sector-p And u-ot-cs-Manager
description:
Location: Kolkata
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: Sep 17, 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1745035
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**GDS Consulting** – **Business Analyst/P\&U\-OT/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) SMR – Manager/Senior**


**The opportunity**



We’re looking for SMRs at Manager/Senior rank with expertise in **Business Analysis/****Operational Technology/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)**to join the P\&U Sector group of **GDS Consulting** **Team**. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Analyse, understand and document client needs from a Business perspective and work with the client to arrive at optimal solutions leveraging the experience and expertise in OT/Control systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)
* Identify and implement business process re\-design and continuous improvements, working closely with Clients, Operations teams, and other business areas
* Lead Project Scope Study workshops to understand the scope and key business requirements which must be met during the Execution phase
* Identify integration needs with any other in house/third party systems and provide detailed information about these systems to Solution Architects as well as Technical Team
* Act as an interface between Client Teams and Technical Team
* Explore opportunities for transformation and suggest ideas/recommend ways to transform the way the client works to be truly digital in the Digital Era to outperform competitors and gain advantage in the market
* Ability to assess Value Potential of a Transmission \& Distribution transformation program and ability to architect the value proposal
* Identify and develop commercialization solutions with substantial growth potential for  

power distribution clients, and provide advisory services to clients

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Strong understanding and experience with the electric utility industry, including knowledge of Grid Operations, Field Operations, Smart Grids and Digital Grid
* Deliver large/medium P\&U Sector specific solutions/OT (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) as well as Control Systems
* Demonstrate expert core consulting skills and advanced level of OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) knowledge and industry expertise to support delivery to clients
* Understanding Distributed Energy Resources or related experience in clean energy, energy efficiency, storage and solar
* Perform an appropriate role in business development in terms of presales and practice development. for example, presales, internal engagement and / or knowledge management
* Experience working with clients throughout various parts of implementation lifecycle
* Proactive with Solution oriented mindset, ready to learn new technologies for Client requirements
* Programme management experience and track record of successful delivery of large, complex programmes
* Demonstrate people management and an ability to conduct and lead consultancy assignments
* Be result oriented as well as people focused
* Be able to manage a team, empathetic and work with Leadership for the development of the overall team

  

  

**Professionals in this role are expected to bring expertise in emerging technologies and advanced solutions that enable utilities to thrive in a digital, sustainable future. These include:**


* **AMI 2\.0 and Advanced Metering Infrastructure**: Next\-generation metering systems that go beyond traditional AMI, enabling real\-time data collection, advanced analytics, and integration with distributed energy resources for improved grid visibility and customer engagement.
* **Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)**: Knowledge of energy storage technologies and their role in grid stability, peak load management, and renewable integration. Ability to assess and design BESS solutions for operational efficiency and resilience.
* **Digital Twin Technologies:** Experience in creating virtual replicas of physical assets and systems to simulate, monitor, and optimise grid operations, predictive maintenance, and scenario planning.
* **Geographic Information Systems (GIS):** Proficiency in GIS platforms for spatial analysis, asset mapping, and network planning to enhance operational decision\-making and outage management.
* **System Integration and Architecture Design:** Capability to design robust integration frameworks and architectures that connect OT systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, SCADA) with IT platforms, ensuring seamless data flow and interoperability.
* **Smart Control Centre Solutions:** Expertise in modern control centre technologies that enable real\-time monitoring, automation, and advanced decision support for grid operations and distributed energy management.
* **Vegetation Management Tools and Strategies:** Familiarity with digital tools and predictive analytics for vegetation monitoring and clearance planning to reduce outage risks and improve reliability.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* Relevant experience in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) Implementation /Technical advisory with total experience between 10 to 15 years (for Manager)
* Relevant experience in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) Implementation/Technical advisory with total experience between 6 to 10 years (for Senior)
* Should be well versed with functional concepts of BA with relevant knowledge in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) and Gap analysis
* Should be well conversant in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA), products/technologies, frameworks, business metadata management and relevant architectural components.
* Strong business analysis skills
* Strong command over business process design

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* Good Business Writing skills
* Good Communication skills
* Maintaining end\-to\-end accountability and expectations for customer satisfaction and overall delivery excellence
* Prioritize deliveries in conjunction with implementation team
* Adopt a proactive, logical and organized approach to problem resolution
* Any relevant product/platform certification

  


**What we look for**


* The incumbent should be able to analyse and manage Business requirements for OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA). Additional knowledge of Business Process Mapping and BPM tools will be an added advantage.
* An opportunity to be a part of Global, market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 10000 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

  


**What working at EY offers**



At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.



You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:


* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Key Accounts Manager Poultry - Kolkata
description:
The Position


As a Key Account Manager, you will play a critical role in driving business growth by building strong, sustainable partnerships with key customers across your assigned territory. You will work closely with leadership, customers, and cross\-functional teams to create mutual value, achieve commercial objectives, and deliver business results in line with company strategy.


Duties \& Responsibilities


* Achieve sales and profitability targets across key accounts within both broiler and layer segments.
* Identify, pursue, and successfully close new business opportunities through the execution of BIAH’s Integrated KAM and Customer Business Planning (CBP) programs.
* Consistently seek opportunities to expand business with existing customers while winning new opportunities through strategic account management.
* Deliver short and mid\-term financial targets for your assigned customers and territory.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, decision\-makers, and management teams within customer accounts.
* Understand customer needs, challenges, and business priorities, and develop solutions that create value for both the customer and BIAH.
* Position BIAH as a trusted partner by identifying opportunities for collaboration and mutual growth.
* Lead the development of comprehensive customer solutions by combining BIAH products and services into compelling value propositions.
* Develop customer\-specific growth strategies based on market analysis, competitive insights, and customer objectives.
* Create and execute Key Account Business Plans aligned with local avian business strategies and organizational goals.
* Optimize account penetration and maximize share of wallet through strategic planning and execution.
* Build and lead effective key account teams to support account growth and opportunity success.
* Ensure clear communication, alignment, and successful execution of agreed account strategies.
* Collaborate with CX teams, Business Unit Managers, Area Business Managers, Business Service Heads, and other stakeholders to deliver customer success.
* Align budgets, investments, and resources with account opportunities to maximize return on investment.
* Provide accurate sales forecasts and business updates to support effective planning and decision\-making.
* Manage commercial agreements, pricing discussions, and receivables with assigned accounts.
* Identify mutual growth opportunities and contribute to performance planning and development discussions for team members.
* Regularly assess account potential, sales performance, market share, and growth opportunities by product segment and species.
* Gather and analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitive intelligence to strengthen business strategies.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date customer information and activity records within the CRM system.
* Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans to drive sustainable growth.
* Maintain effective customer engagement through planned account interactions and agreed contact frequency.
* Utilize data, customer insights, and digital tools to prioritize opportunities and maximize business impact.
* Ensure all administrative responsibilities, reporting requirements, and customer records are completed accurately and on time.

About our Future Employee


* Education : Bachelors degree, Masters degree Veterinary \- Medicine / Economics/ Agriculture degree DVM / Animal Husbandry / Master of Science or Economics and/or Master of Business Administration is preferred.
* Customer focused
* Leadership competencies
* Performance and Return on Investment\-driven personality
* Knowledge of Animal Health Industry Economics
* Ability to work and thrive in matrix team environment
* Proven ability to work cross\-functional
* Interpersonal and communication skills
* Proven field experience of at least 8\-10 years
* History of successful performance.
* Good English in word and writing
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, Outlook and database applications.
* Ability to travel (may include overnight travel).
* Should reside in assigned geography or be willing to relocate.
